name: moonshot
description: Take a real stab at problems that look out of reach or stuck on the usual answer. A user-invoked skill that treats doubt as a prior rather than a verdict: it fixes a checkable goal and budget, generates out-of-pocket candidates (unexpected uses of a technology, changed ways of working, broken assumptions) before judging any, gives the best bet and the wildest a real, measured try against the usual way, verifies every claim before reporting it, and never edits the check or routes around permissions, policies, and sandboxes.
